compatibility.scope: Actual saved first-task samples/transforms, FP32/CPU2, batch64, seed1993, workers4 and GPU1; size-specific weights and execution times differ.

efficiency.std_definition: Sample SD (ddof=1) across three same-seed executions; excludes the fourth partial-FLOPs diagnostic.

measurement_scope.accuracy: Same-size independent author/native two-task checks and separate first-task TII1+prompt1 pilot accuracy. No full-sequence accuracy or forgetting is inferred.
measurement_scope.budgets: Same input and phase/epoch budgets across sizes; FLOPs and parameter counts differ. TII mapping ratio2 is retained. Task1 classifier alignment is not applicable.
measurement_scope.pretraining: AugReg IN21K to IN1K fine-tuned family. Selected checkpoint filenames identify Base aug_medium/weight_decay0.1, Small aug_light1/weight_decay0.03 and Tiny aug_none/weight_decay0.03; size comparisons include those recipe effects.
measurement_scope.time: Recorder process and inclusive synchronized phase wall time; final W&B upload/finish lies outside Recorder sampling.
measurement_scope.energy: Sampled physical GPU-board power integration; excludes CPU/RAM/whole-machine energy and may include other board activity.
measurement_scope.memory: CUDA allocator/device peaks and process-tree RSS have different scopes; shared RSS pages can be counted multiple times.
measurement_scope.flops: One separate partial supported-operator pass per size; omitted/unsupported operators and CPU clustering prevent a complete-method estimate.
measurement_scope.history: Base reuses historical observations from its preserved source worktree. Different execution dates and source snapshots may introduce timing drift.
